title.narrative: 23M-CLEAN - Greening San Andrés: Sustainable Tourism to Reduce Single Use Packaging

description.narrative: By implementing a sustainable and circular approach to packaging, the project directly contributes to Colombia's objectives of promoting environmental conservation, reducing waste, and fostering sustainable economic growth. It supports the national regulation on single-use plastics (Law 1973 of 2019) by offering an alternative to such materials. Furthermore, the project aligns with Colombia's National Development Plan, which emphasizes the importance of sustainable production and consumption patterns. The adoption of Kleen Hub's system can stimulate local entrepreneurship, generate employment opportunities, and enhance the region's tourism sector, contributing to the economic and social well-being of San Andrés. Ultimately, the project sets a model for Colombia's regions to adopt sustainable practices, aiming for a greener and more prosperous future.
